TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_REGION_DIM_SELECT_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_REGION_DIM_SELECT_SRC
(
                SOLIDSET_SET_ID,
                SOLIDSET_SOL_ID,
                SOLIDSET_BANK_ID,
                SOLIDSET_ENTITY_CRE_FLG,
                SOLIDSET_DEL_FLG,
                SOLIDSET_LCHG_USER_ID,
                SOLIDSET_LCHG_TIME,
                SOLIDSET_RCRE_USER_ID,
                SOLIDSET_RCRE_TIME,
                SOLIDSET_TS_CNT,
                SOLIDSET_DUMMY_FLD,
                SOLIDSET_SCD_Start_Date,
                SOLIDSET_SCD_End_Date,
                SOLIDSET_isActive,
                SOLIDSET_isLatest,
                SOLIDSET_BNK_CODE,
                SOLIDSET_SOURCE_CODE,
                SOLIDSET_FILE_NAME,
                SOLIDSET_insert_dttm,
                SETID_SET_ID,
                SETID_BANK_ID,
                SETID_SET_DESC,
                SETID_LCHG_USER_ID,
                SETID_LCHG_TIME,
                SETID_RCRE_USER_ID,
                SETID_RCRE_TIME,
                SETID_TS_CNT,
                SETID_ALT1_SET_DESC,
                SETID_RSIS_ALIAS,
                SETID_SCD_Start_Date,
                SETID_SCD_End_Date,
                SETID_isActive,
                SETID_isLatest,
                SETID_BNK_CODE,
                SETID_SOURCE_CODE,
                SETID_FILE_NAME,
                SETID_insert_dttm,
				JSRC_FLG, 
				JTAR_FLG 
)

SELECT
             SOLIDSET.SET_ID AS SOLIDSET_SET_ID
            ,SOLIDSET.SOL_ID AS SOLIDSET_SOL_ID
            ,SOLIDSET.BANK_ID AS SOLIDSET_BANK_ID
            ,SOLIDSET.ENTITY_CRE_FLG AS SOLIDSET_ENTITY_CRE_FLG
            ,SOLIDSET.DEL_FLG AS SOLIDSET_DEL_FLG
            ,SOLIDSET.LCHG_USER_ID AS SOLIDSET_LCHG_USER_ID
            ,SOLIDSET.LCHG_TIME AS SOLIDSET_LCHG_TIME
            ,SOLIDSET.RCRE_USER_ID AS SOLIDSET_RCRE_USER_ID
            ,SOLIDSET.RCRE_TIME AS SOLIDSET_RCRE_TIME
            ,SOLIDSET.TS_CNT AS SOLIDSET_TS_CNT
            ,SOLIDSET.DUMMY_FLD AS SOLIDSET_DUMMY_FLD
            ,SOLIDSET.SCD_Start_Date AS SOLIDSET_SCD_Start_Date
            ,SOLIDSET.SCD_End_Date AS SOLIDSET_SCD_End_Date
            ,SOLIDSET.isActive AS SOLIDSET_isActive
            ,SOLIDSET.isLatest AS SOLIDSET_isLatest
            ,SOLIDSET.BNK_CODE AS SOLIDSET_BNK_CODE
            ,SOLIDSET.SOURCE_CODE AS SOLIDSET_SOURCE_CODE
            ,SOLIDSET.FILE_NAME AS SOLIDSET_FILE_NAME
            ,SOLIDSET.insert_dttm AS SOLIDSET_insert_dttm
            ,SETID.SET_ID AS SETID_SET_ID
            ,SETID.BANK_ID AS SETID_BANK_ID
            ,SETID.SET_DESC AS SETID_SET_DESC
            ,SETID.LCHG_USER_ID AS SETID_LCHG_USER_ID
            ,SETID.LCHG_TIME AS SETID_LCHG_TIME
            ,SETID.RCRE_USER_ID AS SETID_RCRE_USER_ID
            ,SETID.RCRE_TIME AS SETID_RCRE_TIME
            ,SETID.TS_CNT AS SETID_TS_CNT
            ,SETID.ALT1_SET_DESC AS SETID_ALT1_SET_DESC
            ,SETID.RSIS_ALIAS AS SETID_RSIS_ALIAS
            ,SETID.SCD_Start_Date AS SETID_SCD_Start_Date
            ,SETID.SCD_End_Date AS SETID_SCD_End_Date
            ,SETID.isActive AS SETID_isActive
            ,SETID.isLatest AS SETID_isLatest
            ,SETID.BNK_CODE AS SETID_BNK_CODE
            ,SETID.SOURCE_CODE AS SETID_SOURCE_CODE
            ,SETID.FILE_NAME AS SETID_FILE_NAME
            ,SETID.insert_dttm AS SETID_insert_dttm
            ,1 AS JSRC_FLG
			,0 AS JTAR_FLG 
FROM eds.DEP_SOLIDSETTABLE AS SOLIDSET
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM eds.DEP_SETIDTABLE WHERE @Datetoprocess BETWEEN SCD_Start_Date AND SCD_End_Date) AS SETID
        ON SOLIDSET.SET_ID = SETID.SET_ID
        AND SOLIDSET.BANK_ID = SETID.BANK_ID    
    WHERE @Datetoprocess BETWEEN SOLIDSET.SCD_Start_Date AND SOLIDSET.SCD_End_Date
        AND SUBSTRING(SOLIDSET.SET_ID, 1, 3) = 'REG';

(

                SOLIDSET_SOL_ID,

                CC.SOLIDSET_DEL_FLG,

                CC.SOLIDSET_isLatest,

                CC.SOLIDSET_SOURCE_CODE,
                CC.SOLIDSET_FILE_NAME,
                CC.SOLIDSET_insert_dttm,
                CC.SETID_SET_ID,
                CC.SETID_BANK_ID,
                CC.SETID_SET_DESC,
                CC.SETID_LCHG_USER_ID,
                CC.SETID_LCHG_TIME,
                CC.SETID_RCRE_USER_ID,
                CC.SETID_RCRE_TIME,
                CC.SETID_TS_CNT,
                CC.SETID_ALT1_SET_DESC,
                CC.SETID_RSIS_ALIAS,
                CC.SETID_SCD_Start_Date,
                CC.SETID_SCD_End_Date,
                CC.SETID_isActive,
                CC.SETID_isLatest,
                CC.SETID_BNK_CODE,
                CC.SETID_SOURCE_CODE,
                CC.SETID_FILE_NAME,
                CC.SETID_insert_dttm,
		        0 AS JSRC_FLG, 
				1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.REGION_DIM CC
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';
	


TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_REGION_DIM_GROUP_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_REGION_DIM_GROUP_SRC
(

                SOLIDSET_ENTITY_CRE_FLG,

                SOLIDSET_isLatest,

                SETID_BNK_CODE,
                SETID_SOURCE_CODE,

	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 1 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP


DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
WHERE FULLDATE = @Datetoprocess;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.REGION_DIM A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_REGION_DIM_GROUP_SRC B ON
COALESCE(A.SOLIDSET_SET_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.SOLIDSET_SET_ID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.SOLIDSET_SOL_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.SOLIDSET_SOL_ID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.SOLIDSET_BANK_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.SOLIDSET_BANK_ID,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1

                SOLIDSET_isLatest,

                SETID_LCHG_USER_ID,

                SETID_SCD_Start_Date,
                SETID_SCD_End_Date,

                SETID_isLatest,
                SETID_BNK_CODE,
                SETID_SOURCE_CODE,

				'9999-12-31',
				1,
				1,
				SRC.SOLIDSET_BNK_CODE,
				'DEP',
				CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS DATETIME)
FROM d360.STG_EDS_REGION_DIM_GROUP_SRC SRC
WHERE JSRC_FLG_CNT = 1;
